shared_elements: anthropomorphic figure in profile-ish stance with raised arm
figure with outstretched arm(s) toward an adjacent object
legs shown as an inverted-U/striding pair
justification: Both depict a single humanoid figure with a marked headgear and an arm extended toward a motif at one side, which is about as generic as figural imagery gets; A is a stick-like schematic silhouette with a horizontal bar and a small oval blob, while B is a densely detailed, naturalistically proportioned winged and bearded figure with muscled limbs, patterned kilt, feather-by-feather wing and a stylised flowering plant. Nothing in the specific attributes (wings, plant, beard, garment) is shared, and the drawing conventions are utterly different, so the resemblance is coincidental rather than traditional.
